text: jason: CI build failed on docs site — mkdocs linkcheck complaining about broken fragment: /guides/sdk/usage.md#python-client-setup jason: This only started after yesterday's MDX -> MkDocs migration. mia: saw that. error in CI: ``` ERROR: Broken fragment '/guides/sdk/usage.md#python-client-setup' -> not found ``` carla: looks like the heading in the doc is 'Python client — setup' (emdash) and mkdocs slugifies differently. can add explicit anchor HTML ``? Not ideal. brian: prefer explicit header ids via markdown: `### Python client {#python-client-setup}` — mkdocs-material supports that. mia: also saw a code block right before the header that's missing a blank line; that can mess up heading parsing. jason: good catch. who can send PR? I can do quick patch: fix heading id and add blank line. will also run linkcheck locally. carla: pls also check for image filenames with spaces in /assets/examples — they cause url-encoding anchor issues and some redirect rules strip fragments. docs-bot: deploy preview created — netlify/preview-2345 jason: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/567 — includes: - add explicit header ids for 3 headings - fix code fence spacing - rename images to dash-case in assets/examples - update mkdocs config: re-enable the slugify plugin and add tests mia: ran `mkdocs build && mkdocs-linkcheck site/site.xml` locally, all green. will re-run CI when PR merges. carla: can we add a tiny lint step to detect headings immediately following fenced codeblocks? I can prototype a grep/awk check and add to pre-commit. brian: ack; also add a note to the migration guide about slug differences between MDX (docusaurus) and MkDocs (mkdocs-material) so future migrations don't surprise folks. deploy-bot: CI passed — preview deployed at https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/branch/fix-anchor-567 jason: thanks all :tada:
